messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty SEV2 triggered: potential billing/metering anomaly detected in ingest pipeline — delayed usage reports and several overage flags. Alerting on abnormal token delta vs expected baseline. Auto-run: initial snapshot + trace id 0x7a3f.

maya: ack — I'm oncall, starting triage. Paging SRE and Billing.

chris: on it. can you paste the alert or query? I want the ingest queue lengths and last successful commit times.

maya: alert payload: 
```
alert: metering.delta_drift
severity: HIGH
metric: tokens_counted - tokens_received > 500000
window: 5m
first_seen: 1901234520
tags: [billing, ingest-tier-a]
trace_id: 0x7a3f
```

sam: looking at the ledger service logs now. seeing a backlog of 'write attempts failed - 502' between 03:02-03:18 UTC. Could be upstream datastore flapping.

billing-bot: snapshot: last_committed_seq: 1245789, last_ingest_time: 1901233400 (20m behind), queued_events: 43k, avg_tokens_per_event: 12.

chris: thanks. I'm checking the kafka consumer lag and the ingest worker autoscaler. Consumer lag spiked ~03:01 UTC. Suspect a rolling deploy around 02:58 introduced a tokenizer change that increases per-request token accounting for some paths.

maya: alex from support — any customer reports?

alex: yes, two customers flagged overage alerts via support widget around 03:20 UTC. Both are high-volume dev orgs. They show a sudden billing spike but usage in their app graphs doesn't match. I told them we're investigating and opened tickets.

sam: grep from ledger service: 
```
2026-03-15T03:04:12Z ERROR write_to_store failed status=502 txn=0x9f23
2026-03-15T03:05:07Z WARN retrying event batch id=8421 size=1200
2026-03-15T03:11:20Z INFO processed batch id=8421 tokens_counted=14532 tokens_received=8923
```

chris: that INFO line shows tokens_counted > tokens_received for the same batch — suspicious. grabbing the tokenizer release notes from the 02:58 deploy.

maya: incident checklist: 1) assess customer impact 2) stop bleed (fallback) 3) reconcile ledger 4) mitigation communs 5) handoff. Assigning owners: chris = mitigation, sam = ledger/recon, alex = customer comms, maya = incident lead.

chris: mitigation proposal: rollback tokenizer change on ingest workers or flip runtime flag to legacy counter. I can flip the feature flag w/out full rollback. Doing a canary to 10% first.

sam: starting a reconciliation job on archived events to compute authoritative counts and detect drift windows. Kicking off a high-priority BigQuery job: `bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT batch_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_archive FROM raw_events WHERE ts between TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() GROUP BY batch_id'` — job id bgq_recon_1901.

billing-bot: note: auto-overage alerts were generated by the usage-monitor rule `monthly_thresholds`. I am pausing new alert emails for affected orgs until we have recon results (:no_bell:).

chris: feature flag flipped to legacy counting on canary (10%). Observing immediate drop in delta for canary traces. Proceeding to rollout to all ingest workers now.

maya: please comment when rollout complete. Also we need to surface expected remediation ETA for ops notes and support.

chris: rollout complete at 03:38 UTC. token delta back within normal thresholds for all canaries and progressively for production.

sam: reconciliation job started at 03:41 UTC. initial progress: 12% scanned, encountering a subset of batches with missing tokens_received field — looks like a schema evolution bug in the 02:58 deploy.

alex: posted initial customer comms draft to #support-templates for review: "We're investigating potential incorrect usage spikes affecting a subset of customers. We're pausing billing alerts and will reconcile usage. No action required from customers at this time."

maya: good. Finance needs an estimate on potential overbilled amount. @finance-bot can you give an early calc based on queued_events and avg tokens?

finance-bot: preliminary calc: queued_events 43k * avg_tokens_per_event 12 * $0.000012/token = ~$6.20 estimated immediate exposure. Note: this is a lower-bound naive calc; impacted orgs are high-volume so ledger reconciliation required for final numbers.

sam: recon job output snippet (partial): 
```
batch_id:8421 tokens_archive:8923 tokens_ingested:14532 delta:+5609
batch_id:8422 tokens_archive:10345 tokens_ingested:10340 delta:-5
```

chris: that confirms token inflation for specific batches where tokenizer produced larger token_count. Root cause seems to be a change in tokenization heuristics in the deploy plus a codepath that double-counted prefix tokens when a cached partial was present. Fix landed in the rollback branch and we disabled the cache merge step.

maya: action items: 
- Support to notify affected customers and open refund tickets (owner: alex)
- Billing to queue one-off adjustments after full recon (owner: sam -> billing team)
- Finance to prepare a provisional credit batch (owner: finance-bot -> finance ops)
- Eng to add a regression test for token counting and add an alert for tokens_counted > tokens_received (owner: chris)

alex: notifying affected customers now with template + ETA ~3 hours for final reconciliation.

sam: full reconciliation expected in ~2.5 hours; will update thread when done. Running a streaming check to ensure no further write errors.

chris: adding a temporary more-sensitive metering alert to catch any re-occurrence (:eyes:). Also adding telemetry to capture per-runner tokenizer version.

maya: we should prepare a post-incident blameless RCA. For now, tag the deploy owner and add to the release notes.

chris: tag @release-owner in the release changelog. I'll PR a unit/regression test.

billing-bot: paused auto-overage alerts cleared at 04:12 UTC for unaffected orgs. re-enabled for systems where recon shows parity.

sam: reconciliation complete at 05:20 UTC (1901241767). final summary: ~0.9% of batches in the 03:00-03:30 window had inflated token counts, total overcount corresponds to estimated $78.40 exposure across 6 orgs; ledger corrected with backfill and billing adjustments queued.

maya: thanks team. Incident downgraded to postmortem. Will schedule RCA and send out summary to stakeholders. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident SEV2 -> RESOLVED at 1901241767. Root cause: tokenizer change + cache merge bug in 02:58 deploy causing token-count inflation; mitigation: rollback/feature-flag and ledger reconciliation.
